title: CWP/17393/2025 of SUDESH LAL AND ORS Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND ORS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision: 25.07.2025 Sudesh Lal and others ….Petitioners Versus State of Punjab and others ….Respondents CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE HARSH BUNGER Present : Mr. Sandeep Lather HARSH BUNGER, J. (Oral) The present petition has been filed inter alia seeking issuance of a writ in the nature of Mandamus for directing the respondents to appoint an administrator of Gram Panchayat, Village Alial, District Pathankot and to take action against the Sarpanch for doing work against the interest of Gram Panchayat and also for permitting the encroacher to raise construction. 1.1 A further prayer has been made for marking an inquiry against the Sarpanch as to how and in what circumstances, he had withdrawn the Civil Suit.

2. Learned State counsel, on instructions from Ms. Parminder Kaur, Assistant Director, Complaints, Rural Development Panchayat, informs the Court that on the basis of the complaints received against the Sarpanch, an explanation shall be called from the Sarpanch within a period of three weeks from today and if the circumstances so warrant, the matter would be inquired into by the concerned authorities.

3. Keeping in view the aforesaid submissions made by learned State counsel, no further orders are required to be passed in the instant writ petition, therefore the same is accordingly disposed of.

4. All pending application(s), if any, shall also stand closed. 25.07.2025 (HARSH BUNGER) Himani JUDGE
